newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Avonmore completes acquisition of Beni Foods.
newsitem.headline: Avonmore completes acquisition of Beni Foods.

text.p: Avonmore Foods Plc said on Monday that it had agreed to buy the 90 percent of Beni Foods Limited that it does not already own for a consideration of 45 million sterling.
Beni, which is based in Milton Keynes, is a leading player in the UK sliced cooked meats market.
Avonmore acquired a 10 percent stake in Beni for 5.0 million sterling, including repayment of intercompany debt, on May 7.
It also entered into put/call option agreements for the remaining 90 percent.
The 45 million consideration is payable on a deferred basis with 10 million sterling due on May 7, 1998, May 7, 1999 and May 5, 2000 and a final payment of 15.0 million sterling due on May 4, 2001.
The options were exercisable up unti October 18, 1997.
